personality_one_liner: A high-performance dark-mode threat intelligence and incident response command center for mobile users.

spacing.rule: Clean operational spacing for fast threat triage, 8pt baseline grid.

do's: Use solid contrast borders and clear tonal division for high-density security telemetry
dont's: Avoid heavy glass blurs that reduce clarity on live security feeds

screens.name: CommandCenter
screens.purpose: Core overview of active threat scans, workflow state, and quick triage actions.

states.empty: No active threat scans logged today.
states.error: Failed to sync telemetry. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Top status bar with role badge, scan progress ring, threat count metrics, and quick action cards for Scan, Detect, Verify, Classify, Score, Link, and Report.

screens.name: RelationshipGraph
screens.purpose: Interactive relationship graph detailing threat networks, IP nodes, and scam entities.
screens.layout: Centered focal node with expandable connected entity nodes, risk weighting badges, and bottom sheet details.

screens.name: ScreenshotOCR
screens.purpose: Screenshot upload via device library or paste/data URL with instant OCR threat analysis.

states.empty: No screenshot uploaded yet. Tap or paste to begin.
states.error: OCR extraction failed. Please try a clearer image.

screens.layout: Upload dropzone with library and paste URL triggers, followed by extracted text preview and confidence risk markers.

screens.name: CloneDetection
screens.purpose: Visual and DOM clone detection scanner for fraudulent websites and spoofed social profiles.

states.loading: Comparing DOM signatures and visual similarity...

screens.layout: URL input bar, side-by-side visual similarity score, DOM signature hash comparison, and authenticity verdict card.

screens.name: VictimReports
screens.purpose: Victim-owned report history with shareable JSON evidence report generation and downloading.
screens.layout: Chronological list of incident reports with status tags, Download JSON button, and cryptographic evidence hash preview.

screens.name: SocialVerify
screens.purpose: Victim section for social-media post link verification against known fraud databases.

states.empty: Paste a social post link to verify safety.

screens.layout: Social link input field, platform detector badge (WhatsApp/Telegram/Instagram/X), and safety verdict meter.

screens.name: MultilingualVoiceAI
screens.purpose: Multilingual AI assistant with voice input and spoken link-visit safety instructions in Indian native languages.

states.empty: Select language and tap mic to speak.
states.error: Voice session interrupted. Tap to restart.

screens.layout: Language selector (Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Kannada, Malayalam, Gujarati, Punjabi), voice waveform visualizer, and spoken safety instruction audio card.

screens.name: ComplaintResources
screens.purpose: Official complaint section with toll-free helpline 1930 and direct link to National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal.
screens.layout: Prominent 1930 one-tap dialer banner, cybercrime portal web link card (https://cybercrime.gov.in/Webform/Accept.aspx), and instant evidence attachment trigger.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement all 8 core screens for SafeTap AI Mobile with Dark-First Utility theme. Ensure Role-based access (Victim, Investigator, Admin), Scan->Detect->Verify->Classify->Score->Link->Report workflow, interactive relationship graph details, screenshot upload with OCR, visual/DOM clone detection, victim-owned report history with downloadable JSON evidence, social-media post link verification, multilingual voice AI in 9 Indian languages with spoken safety instructions, and the complaint section with 1930 and cybercrime portal link.
